snippet.title: Strix and Scholar - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#indiegame #romantasy #romancegame #fantasygames #gamergirl #booklover #darkacademia 

Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4518070/Strix_and_Scholar/

Follow the story of Blanca Silverurn—a strix entangled in a murder mystery. Explore the Grimstrand campus and learn about its unique magic. Delve into the secrets of students and faculty members. Affect their relationships, including a spicy romance between Blanca and her enigmatic mentor.
